concepts.gloss_en: The eating of Shabbat (the act/food of Sabbath eating, source of blessing for the six days; no share for the sitra achra)

members.note: same construct אכילת שבת with temporal preposition בשעת ('at the time of'); identical referent, only framing differs

concepts.gloss_en: Oneg Shabbat, the delight of the Sabbath (construct head ענג, not אכילה); equated with גורל and eating-in-holiness but a distinct construct

members.note: representative; different construct head (ענג vs אכילה) per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: The eating of the oneg of Shabbat (head אכילה, object ענג שבת); associated with matzah / 'למען תמצו והתענגתם'

members.note: three-term construct with object ענג שבת; distinct object from bare אכילת שבת per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: The delight of the eating of Shabbat (head ענג, object אכילת שבת); distinct from ענג שבת and from אכילת ענג שבת by construct head/object order

members.note: head ענג over object אכילת שבת; different head from אכילת ענג שבת and different object from ענג שבת per rule 4

notes: All four core forms share the semantic field (eating/delight/Shabbat) but differ by construct head and object, so per rule 4 they are kept separate. אכילת ענג שבת and ענג אכילת שבת are near-twins that a reviewer may wish to reconsider, but their construct heads differ (אכילה vs ענג); their proof snippets in lm1:57 do not disambiguate the exact form, so they were left distinct under the under-merge default. Only בשעת אכילת שבת was folded into אכילת שבת, since it is that same construct with a temporal preposition.
